terbaru.pelajaran: This paper describes a fully open-source pipeline that reproduces the behavior of a cloud-native, event-driven system -- file arrival triggering a message, a message triggering compute -- entirely on commodity hardware, using Apache Kafka and a filesystem-watching poller in place of managed cloud triggers.

terbaru.pelajaran: This work proposes a retrieval-augmented expert-switching framework that dynamically selects portfolio management experts based on their historical performance under similar market situations.

terbaru.judul: TagZilla: Automated Owner and Abuse Type Tagging for Indicators of Compromise in Threat Reports
terbaru.pelajaran: This paper presents TagZilla, a platform that, given a threat report, automatically analyzes its text and tags the IoCs it describes with contextual information about the threat group and malware family that the IoC belongs to and the type of abuse associated with the IoC (e.g., phishing, sextortion, command-and-control).
